name: airfone
description: AirFone telecom self-service portal: Angular web app + FastAPI API + MySQL.

scripts.setup: cd api && uv sync && uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run python -m app.seed --demo && cd ../web && npm ci
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "cd api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000" "npm start --prefix web"
scripts.test: cd api && uv run pytest && cd ../web && npm test
scripts.lint: cd api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && cd ../web && npm run format:check
